description: [WRITE] Create a NATIVE Google server tag in a SERVER container workspace, built with the correct shape: platform "ga4" = the GA4 relay (sgtmgaaw; omit eventName to relay every incoming event, pass one for a per-event tag; optional eventParameters / userProperties enrichment rows), "ads_conversion" = Google Ads conversion (sgtmadsct; conversionId + conversionLabel), "ads_conversion_linker" = the server Conversion Linker (sgtmadscl), "ads_remarketing" = Google Ads remarketing (sgtmadsremarket; conversionId). Pass the SERVER trigger id(s) as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

conversionId.description: For ads_conversion / ads_remarketing: the Ads Conversion ID (AW- prefix is stripped).

eventName.description: For ga4: a literal event name for a per-event tag; omit to relay every event.

eventParameters.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

measurementId.description: For ga4: the G- Measurement ID or a {{variable}}.

productReporting.description: For ads_conversion: enable product reporting (ecommerce only).

userProperties.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_server_tag
